pages.text: Restore a quarry corpse’s core or one from a Forgotten Mining Slime through $(l:world/mine_recovery)mine recovery$(). No crafting recipe exists. Its summon item shows a purple-edged core on a gold plate; the companion has a helmet and white ancient crest.

It prioritizes visible Forge-tagged ores in its active quarry layer and spends half the normal stamina on movement, mining, draining, and reinforcement. The bonus neither exposes distant deposits nor skips layers. Detection Range and Reach still limit its work.

Use the ordinary $(l:companions/mining)Mining Slime$() controls: pickaxe, shovel, bag, Mine order, bucket, and wall supplies. Transport and Warehouse Slimes unload it and supply tools, buckets, and cobblestone. Shared stairs remain protected. Recovery, portals, and first release select Wait.
